## Description

Applies Dynamic Mode Decomposition (a spatio-temporal data-driven technique from fluid dynamics) to extract coherent spatial structures and complex growth/decay modes from cross-sectional price fields.

## Where it may fit

Coordinated sector rotations, systemic market sell-offs, cross-asset momentum propagation.

## Vehicles

Quantitative Equity Funds, Cross-Asset Statistical Arbitrage Desks.

## Required data

High-dimensional cross-sectional matrix of asset prices or return time series.

## Caveats

Sensitive to noise in high-frequency regimes; rank reduction choice in Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) is critical.
